known_for.title: AND1 Mixtape X: The United Streets of America
known_for.original_title: AND1 Mixtape X: The United Streets of America
known_for.overview: The 10th volume takes it back to the streets, where it all started. Crash the courts with AND 1's best as they take on ballers from DC, Indy, Houston and LA in this slammin' selection of the tightest moves from the "United Streets of America" tour. Relive the greatest moments from all ten years as today's crew look back at the best of what Volumes 1-9 had to offer. Stars: The Professor, Hot Sauce, Baby Shack, Bad Santa.Take it from the courts to the streets as the AND 1 crew celebrates its 10th anniversary and takes a look back at their best moments from the previous nine years with the hoop stars from Houston, LA, Indiana, and Washington D.C.

known_for.title: Justice Ninja Style
known_for.overview: Brad Tolan is a martial arts instructor who moves to De Soto to open a karate school. he is framed by chief deputy George and his partner officer Grady for a murder he did not commit and is thrown in jail, uncertain if he will ever see a trial. with the help of a mysterious ninja, Brad escapes from jail and must evade capture while he tries to clear his name. when George forms a posse of angry townsfolk to take out the fugitive, it is up to brad and the ninja topple George and expose corruption on the force.

results.title: Lady Ninja Kasumi 6: Yukimura Assasination
results.original_title: 真田くノ一忍法伝 かすみ 内乱！幸村暗殺！！
results.overview: The story revolves around a man named Takuma who works under the legendary samurai Sanada Yukimura teaching a secret technique called â€œKakure Musouâ€. However, Sanada won't allow Takuma to actually fight for him because he's hampered by a painful disease of the eyes. It's the worst kind of humiliation for a warrior like Takuma. A woman, played by Asami (Sukeban Boy, The Machine Girl), eventually makes a special medicine that helps him recover from his affliction. known_for.name: The Simpsons
known_for.overview: Set in Springfield, the average American town, the show focuses on the antics and everyday adventures of the Simpson family; Homer, Marge, Bart, Lisa and Maggie, as well as a virtual cast of thousands. Since the beginning, the series has been a pop culture icon, attracting hundreds of celebrities to guest star. The show has also made name for itself in its fearless satirical take on politics, media and American life in general.

known_for.title: Facing Ali
known_for.overview: Ten of Muhammad Ali's former rivals pay tribute to the three-time world heavyweight champion.

known_for.title: Dirty Movie
known_for.overview: An outrageous cut-rate producer is about to fulfill his lifelong dream to make a movie about the most offensive, dirtiest jokes ever told. As Charlie and his filmmaking team hilariously struggle to write a script and assemble their award-winning cast, the movie-within-a-movie emerges with one dirty joke after another. Only one can take the crown for writing the dirtiest joke ever told, and Charlie will do whatever he can to be that king.

results.title: The Assasination of a Devious Officer
results.overview: A group of four robbers open a house and are surprised to see that the occupant of the house was already tied up. What they don't know, however, is that a police officer was in the bathroom at the time, preparing for a sexual power play with the bound resident. While Clinty is looking for money in the house, the clueless cop appears out of nowhere and startles Donnie, Michalakis and Patsidis. One of the three of them freaks out and shoots him. The robbers turn into fugitives overnight and Clady, who was not present at the incident, must now interrogate his friends and solve the crime while being forced to listen to their silly excuses. Who knows if Clydee has a much more personal motive for solving the case?

results.title: Orphan: First Kill
results.overview: After escaping from an Estonian psychiatric facility, Leena Klammer travels to America by impersonating Esther, the missing daughter of a wealthy family. But when her mask starts to slip, she is put against a mother who will protect her family from the murderous “child” at any cost.

results.title: Unidentified Murder
results.overview: Alien Alert!!! An influencer couple staged a harmless prank in pursuit of clicks and likes. Little do they know, their little escapade has gone out of control and spiraled into a real tragedy. A series of accidents, followed by blackmails and Extraterrestrial Encounters somehow echo and unveil the myth of a myterious child disappearnace 25 years ago! A group of five, a chain of bizzare events, layers of schemes and plot twists. It's all-you-can-experience in One Crazy Night!

results.title: The Assassins
results.overview: In his old age, Cao Cao assesses his former military tactics, love, and relationship with his son.

results.title: Bodyguards and Assassins
results.overview: In 1905, revolutionist Sun Yat-sen came to Hong Kong to meet revolutionary comrades. The Qing government sent a group of killers to murder him. Ordinary citizens from all walks of life joined together, blocking the streets and fighting off the assassins to keep Sun Yat-sen safe.

results.title: Blood and Black Lace
results.overview: Isabella, a young model, is murdered by a mysterious masked figure at a fashion house in Rome. When her diary, which details the house employees' many vices, disappears, the masked killer begins killing off all the models in and around the house to find it.

results.title: Killer Coach
results.overview: After a one-night stand with her coach, a pressured swimming phenom finds the lives of herself and her loved ones in danger.

results.title: Killer Unicorn
results.overview: A Brooklyn party boy is excited to go to a huge party event, but the night takes a turn when he is attacked by a stranger. A year later, he gives his social life a second chance, but a man wearing a unicorn mask is killing his friends one by one.

results.title: Murder by Invitation
results.overview: The relatives of a rich old woman unsuccessfully try to have her declared insane, so they can divide up her money. To show them that there are no hard feelings, she invites them to her estate for the weekend so she can decide to whom she actually will leave her money when she dies. Soon, however, family members begin turning up dead.

results.name: My Serial Killer Lover
results.overview: Charlie, a professor of criminal psychology at the university, has been haunted by the murder of his mother for years, with nightmares and visions of her corpse clad in blood often coming back into his mind. Using his knowledge and university resources, Charlie does the only thing he can by supporting the police to help track down the elusive serial killer who killed his mother; 'Falcon' For years, Charlie has been at a dead end-that is, until one day, a bright young student named Hunter enters his class. With Hunter's shared passion and extensive knowledge of 'Falcon', the two quickly form a deep connection that blossoms into something much more. But what starts off as love quickly turns into something much more sinister as the true intentions of Charlie, Hunter, and the police become revealed.

results.title: The Assassination
results.overview: The friendship of two friends is tested when the mysterious organization they both work for contact them with new directions.
